name: amass
title: OWASP Amass
description: OWASP Amass — comprehensive subdomain enumeration and DNS reconnaissance from dozens of public + active sources (certificate transparency, DNS brute, scraping, web archives, reverse-whois). Set AMASS_DOMAIN to the apex domain; AMASS_PASSIVE=true restricts to non-touching sources for stealth, AMASS_TIMEOUT caps the run in minutes, and AMASS_RESOLVERS provides a custom resolver list (comma-separated). Emits one Faraday host per unique IP with all subdomains pointing at it as hostnames.
